entities.summary: Archangela Girlani, O.Carm, was an Italian Carmelite nun known for her miracles, mystical visions, austerity, religious ecstasies and levitation. She was prioress of two convents, in Parma and in Mantua. Pope Pius IX beatified her on 1 October 1864.
